segments.en: Thank you for coming, Roger Smith.
...What sort of request is it this time?
Are you aware that Grados has begun to move?
You mean that the Grados fleet is headed for this city?
Yes. Grados is finally coming to attack.
It seems they no longer have any need for our company's power.
Even so, I intend to keep the good citizens from being placed under tyranny, whatever it takes.
Are you saying you want me to mediate negotiations with the Resistance?
I knew that sooner or later, this day would come.
That is precisely why I have accommodated your requests until now.
...Understood. I'll do everything I can.
I'm expecting good work from you, Roger Smith.
This is where it all begins.

rows.notes: [editorial 6] 'stop the good citizens from' could read as stopping the citizens | [editorial 11] 'counting on your work' stiff | [editorial 13] accuracy flag: 'only the beginning' added a more-to-come nuance; hajimari = the beginning

segments.en: Now, what should I do?
GEAR HQ Command Center
Huh? What's this?
An unidentified flying object is approaching Hoshimi Town at high speed!
An enemy scout plane?!
Can you hear me? You're picking this up, right, "GEAR" HQ?
Who are you?!
Just a hired delivery man.
It's express mail, so I'm landing straight on the Iron Gear!
Hey! Stop right there!
Whew~! He forced his way down. That's some serious flying.
...Wait, this is no time to be impressed! Who the heck is this guy?!
Yo!
Huh? Hey, are you...
I'm Spike. The bounty hunter who caught you guys before.
Sorry about that time.
Right now I'm here as Roger's messenger.
Roger Smith? Did something happen in Paradigm City?
The Grados Army's on the move. Looks like they're finally gonna crush Paradigm...
So we could use your help.
Roger said that?
Seems the head of Paradigm himself asked him to...
That's odd. We should have heard from the Resistance.
That'd be way too late. The enemy would be here by then.
Besides, I didn't come here on Alex's orders.
Roger and I just don't like the idea of staying under Grados's thumb like this.
Then, Spike, why don't you fight alongside us?
With your skills, you'd fit right in.
Fine...
But I'm not about to be tied down by your grand cause. I'll do things my own way.
Spike has joined the unit.

Machine added:
Swordfish II
You must be tired after flying all the way here in that plane. I'll have a room prepared for you.
Appreciate it...
Someone show Spike to his room.
Oh, then I'll...
Lead the way, young lady.
Oh, y-yes...

rows.notes: Seg 2 has no header; read as Elise continuing her report. [jp] (Dendoh's home town) is not in the glossary: rendered "Hoshimi". Seg 4: Spike's [jp] kept with the quoted name: "GEAR" HQ. | [editorial 2] term: Hoshimi Town, as in 4014_09502_02 captions and 4822_10353 | [editorial 18] accuracy flag: 'borrow your help' stiff; Spike's casual voice

segments.en: Um... this will be your room.
Thanks...
Huh, not a bad room at all.
Um, Spike... do you know anything about the Resistance?
Ah, so that's what you wanted to ask.
Um... I... the Resistance...
I know, Anna.
Huh?
You fought alongside Eiji and the others in the final battle three years ago, right? That story's pretty famous...
Then... do you know anything about Eiji?
Don't worry. If there were any talk of him being dead, Grados would be gleefully spreading it around.
Plus, I've heard word that the Resistance has started moving on this.
You might get to see him soon.
Okay. I won't give up hope.

rows.notes: [accuracy 5] added detail removed: JP trails off (watashi, rejisutansu ni...) without saying she was in it; keep the fragment, Spike's reply fills it in

segments.en: Is the enemy really coming?
Probably... I can definitely feel the pressure from Grados.
I don't like leaving this town, but if the enemy takes Paradigm, we'll lose contact with the Resistance.
Master Asia should understand that too.
Then will the Resistance come to Paradigm City too?
Most likely... With luck, we can link up with the Resistance.
We've gotten approval from Commander Shibuya.
Please have the Iron Gear depart as soon as it's ready.
Got it.

rows.notes: Seg 3: [jp] is Master Asia (the Resistance commander, per 3987_09448/4012_09500); no glossary entry for this title, rendered "Commander Master Asia". | [editorial 7] shukkou: 'depart' points at the UI Depart command (accuracy flag); 'set out' was vague

segments.en: Hokuto's House
The next battle... the black Dendoh might show up too.
I've got to be ready for it...
Hokuto?
Waah! Wh-What is it, Mom?
I baked some cookies. Share them with everyone.
Wow! Thanks!
But you told me all of a sudden that you'd be staying over,
so all I could make was something simple.
But they're nice and warm, and they look delicious! Ahahaha... (sweat)
Really...?
Be careful out there. You know... cars and... things can be dangerous.
Yeah...
Um, Mom...
Hm?
N-Never mind! It's nothing!
Well, I'm off!
Take care...
Hokuto...

rows.notes: [jp] rendered "the black Dendoh" (Hokuto doesn't know its name yet). [jp] kept as "(sweat)". | [editorial 7] 'so suddenly that... that' clunky across the page break | [editorial 8] continuation of 5.7

segments.en: Okay, maybe I'll go over the Squad Setup...
Oh, Kanji, wait a moment.
What is it?
I'll be staying here to command the defense force.
I'm leaving Dendoh's command to you.
I see. Understood.
Hokuto, Ginga, hold your own even without me around.
Yes! I'll do my best!!
All right! Guess we just gotta do it, huh!
That's the spirit! Let's drive Grados back with our own hands!
Vega has left the unit.
Set course for Paradigm City!
We have to get there before the Grados Army!
Aye aye!

rows.notes: Seg 2 [jp] rendered "Aye aye!" rather than "Roger!" to avoid confusion with Roger Smith.

segments.en: Looks like we've arrived.
Yeah. Usually this is where they slam the door in our faces, though.
Oh! They're already calling us.
The Iron Gear, eh? The airport has been cleared.
Come in from wherever you like.
Ho~, that's a different welcome from usual.
Never mind that! Just dock already!
Yeah, yeah!
I'm surprised your ship managed to get here ahead of Grados.
It's thanks to Spike. He told us about Grados before the Resistance's network could.
I see. Asking him really was the right call.
Roger. The appointed time is approaching.
So it is.
I've been asked to act as intermediary between you and the Paradigm Corporation.
I'll introduce you to the company's president, Alex Rosewater.
I'll take you to the dome right away. Follow me.
Ah, welcome. Thank you for coming.
I'm the captain, Elchi Cargo. Nice to meet you!
I've heard about you. Your destruction of that Grados supply base in particular was deeply satisfying.
I'll get straight to it. There's actually something I'd like you to accept.

Machines added:
Dugger x1
Promeus x1

Equipment obtained:
EN Booster Lv2 x1
EN Pack Lv2 x1
A gift from the Paradigm Corporation.
They pale next to your machines, but they're still frontline-class. I thought they might be of some use.
Are you sure? You'll be openly ignoring your friendly relations with Grados.
Those relations exist in name only now.
Until now, I've dealt flexibly with Grados for the citizens' sake, but...
I can no longer slip past Grados's watchful eyes.
So I've made up my mind. From now on, I'll be cooperating with the Resistance.
So, when will the enemy get here?
I can't say exactly, but it shouldn't take more than a few days.
Until then, I'd like you to do everything you can. We will spare no effort to help, of course.
All right.
We'll take that mission on!
Thank you. I'm truly grateful for your cooperation.
...How very reliable. Wouldn't you agree, Roger, my boy...?
I'm grateful to you as well. It's thanks to you that our talks with them went so smoothly.
I'll be counting on you from here on, too.
What's wrong, Roger? You seem to be in a bad mood.
I hate men who do things that way.
Elchi... that man, Alex... you'd better not get too involved with him.
I know. But we need to stay on good terms with him for now, don't we?
I see... Then that's fine.
Oh, Kanji! Have you seen Quess?
Quess...? No... I haven't seen her...
I'm going to examine the Psycho-Frame, and I want her to help me. She's a Newtype, you know?
Can't Amuro do it?
I want to try a different pattern too.
What's everybody gathered here for? Something up?
Chan's looking for Quess.
...? Quess? I saw her a little while ago.
Really?
I think she was walking off that way...
Was anyone with her?
Hmm... I think she was probably alone...
I'm worried... A girl walking around alone...
But... I've got machines to service, so I really need to get back soon...
Knowing her, I'm sure she's fine, but...
We'll look for her too, so you head back to the ship, Chan.
She might've gone back to the ship anyway.
I see... Then I'll leave it to you.
Jiron! You walk Chan back, okay?
Huh? Why?
You're gonna let Chan go back alone?
Oh, right.
Oh, it's fine. You don't have to worry about me.
Chan, this town is pretty dangerous. So let's go back together.
All right. Thanks, Jiron.
Geez, Quess... she's such a handful...
Man, with a city this big, finding her is tough...
And if we can't use the police either, we're stuck.
There's no point searching blindly like this. Let's head back to the ship for now.
Quess... where did she go?
Are you sure about leaving the Iron Gear crew?
This time the one you're fighting isn't Amuro, right?
Or would I just be in your way?
No...
Ehe! Sorry, that was mean of me.
I know. I won't get in your way like before, Colonel.
Besides, the info I have should be really valuable to you.
If you're going up against the Redros Army, that is!
Quess! Don't use that name so carelessly.
Hehe! Well? Feel like taking me with you now?
Heh... You win...
Ehehe! Then let's go!
Is this it? The Sazabi's cockpit!
Can you use it?
Of course!
There's hardly any energy left in it...
Will just the cartridges here be enough?
It'll be fine... Lend me your strength too, Colonel.
Concentrate. Think it: "I want to go back to space."
Back to space...
Kanji! Come here a sec!
What's wrong? Why the rush?
Just come on up here!
You're here too, Kanji.
What's going on?
Abnormal energy is coming from the Nu Gundam's cockpit.
Chan! Show him the frame.
The frame...?
Look! The Psycho-Frame is resonating!
Whoa! It's glowing again!
Someone is trying to open a gate to space...
A gate...? No way...!
Hm... This feeling... It's the space we came from.
What?! Char?!
Amuro...?!
Hey! Something's weird with the sky!
Just come and look!
What? What is it?
Let's get outside too!
Wh... what is that...!
The sky right above the city... it's connected to space!
Just as I thought... It's a door that's been opened once, so it opens more easily now...
Is this the result of the Psycho-Frame's resonance?
Colonel! Here we go!!
Right!
A pillar of light?!
Looks like Quess and Char have gone up into space.
Then that pillar of light... Quess did that?
Probably...
Anyway, let's go check it out!
Amuro! Will you come with me?
Got it!
Quess has left the unit.

rows.notes: Seg 22 has no header; read as Amuro continuing (he sensed it in seg 21 and names Char in seg 23). [jp] rendered "space". | [editorial 7] accuracy flag: 'Wish that you want to go back' clumsy

segments.en: It's around here...
You can tell?
Over there!
This is the center of the pillar of light.
A pile of scrap...?
I see... So they used the Sazabi's cockpit.
What do you mean?
The Sazabi's cockpit uses a Psycho-Frame.
They must have used it to open the gate...
So the Psycho-Frame is the key to opening the gate...?
That's the only explanation... Though I don't know how they did it...
That's how it was when I came to Terra, too...
When Axis was about to fall to Earth...
people's minds gathered in the Psycho-Frame, and it overloaded...
That's right... That's how Axis was kept from falling to Earth.
It's still a mystery... what that was...
That must have been when the gate to another world opened...
After that, Char and I came down to the world of Terra.
By the time I came to, Char's pod was gone.
And I was lucky enough to be picked up by the Iron Gear.
So that's what happened...
(Come to think of it, Lun had the power to control the pillars of light too...)
(Was that the power of people's minds, their will, or whatever you call it...?)
(If the Psycho-Frame is what amplifies that kind of thing...)
(then creating gates artificially becomes possible, too...)
I don't know how to handle the Psycho-Frame...
Quess pulled off something we couldn't.
But still, to think people's minds have that kind of power...
Hm? Who's there?!
I didn't mean to eavesdrop, but...
Roger!
Are you interested in that light too?
Something like that... Has that phenomenon happened many times before?
I've seen it before... though I don't know what it is.
The people of this city usually show no interest in it.
But lately, the Military Police have been frantically investigating it...
In any case, it'd be best to leave this place...
Let's do that...
I'll give you a ride. I'm on my way to the Iron Gear myself.
That'd help. Please do.
Then let's go. My car is parked nearby.
Still, this area is a far cry from inside the domes.
...Looks like nobody's kept it up at all.
A new city is built on the foundations of the old one.
And the abandoned city rots away like this...
Look who's talking. Haven't you been reaping plenty of the benefits?
Wha...! Who's there?!!
Long time no see, Negotiator!
Beck! What do you think you're doing?!
Heh! This is what I'm doing!!
Terminator Police!!
Grados's unmanned weapons!!
Beck! What is the meaning of this!!
Don't make a fuss, Negotiator.
It's a simple deal. Hand over the Iron Gear's crew!
What do you intend to do with them?!
I'll hand them over to Grados. Relax, I won't take their lives.
You're telling us to surrender to Grados?!
Like hell we will!
Don't move, I said!! You that eager to die?
Well? How about it, Negotiator?
This is far too... unfair!
Not really. Take a look!
How about it? This money's yours. Not a bad deal, is it?
This isn't a smart way to do business. As if I could accept money like this!
I'm just doing what my client told me to. You get it...
Letting you live is just my sense of fair play.
I'm a professional negotiator!
Even a child would see that such an unfair deal is a losing one!
It ain't unfair. You come out ahead.
Most people would choose to take the money...
Roger! This is beyond a negotiator's domain...
But...
Yeah... What we're doing is war.
I'm sorry...
Heh... Then it's a deal...!
Amuro, was it? As of now, you're hostages!
Now we're going to disarm the Iron Gear. Lead the way!!
Got it...
So long, Negotiator!
Hey, Beck! Looks like you pulled it off.
I don't slip up.
Kid Horla!!
So this was your doing too!
Yeah, that's right!
This time I'll capture the Iron Gear for sure!
Why side with Grados?! You were born on Terra too, weren't you?
Siding with the client who pays best is only natural.
The Resistance and Grados are like night and day!
And who the hell are you people anyway!
If you hadn't shown up, Elchi wouldn't have become a wanted woman!!
What?! Don't give me that crap!
Heh... Whatever. I'll get that out of you later! Come with me!!

rows.notes: Seg 14: Kanji's [jp] kept as recalling the Axis incident. Seg 92: [jp] rendered as Horla turning the question back on them. | [accuracy 57] subject restored: Beck himself is handing the crew over (answers Roger's 'what will you do with them') | [editorial 50] accuracy flag: 'This is what!!' odd; answers Roger's 'what do you think you're doing' | [editorial 81] vocative split by '!' read oddly | [editorial 83] vocative split by '!' read oddly | [proofread 46] punctuation: question marked with '!!' only; '?!!' (as Amuro's 'Who's there?!' at 16.28) | [proofread 56] punctuation: direct question (Beck answers); '?!' per editorial flag

segments.en: Outskirts of Paradigm City
Horla!! Taking hostages... how low can you get!
The Grados main force is here! There's no way the Iron Gear can win!
I'm telling you I'll save you before that happens!!
So you're running away just because you can't beat them?!
That's right! You won't know until you try!
Anyway, we've got the hostages. Hurry up and decide what you're gonna do!
Grr...!
Well, I suppose it's about time...
Big O! Showtime!!
Don't tell me... he's going to take them on?
Go! Get 'em!
That's pouring oil on the fire...
Boss! Some weird thing's coming our way!
What?!
It's a Megadeus! It showed up again!
Is it one of theirs?!
No... it's not with them! But it's no friend of ours either!
Waaaaaah!!
Damn it! Counterattack!!
Perfect! Now we can slide right into a fight!
All right! Let's go too!!
Make it as flashy as you can!
Meanwhile, someone get to the enemy ship and rescue Amuro and Kanji!
Leave that to us.
Well then, we'll just pop over there!
Iron Gear! Commencing battle!!
Yeah! Let's do this!
Since Kanji and Amuro are absent, this battle will be fought with a special squad.
Handle it with the squad you've been given.

rows.notes: Seg 12 [jp] (Geraba to Horla) rendered "Boss". Seg 24: Sai Saici speaks for himself and George; rendered with "we".

segments.en: This is bad, Boss!
Don't panic! We've got a trump card. They won't be able to finish us off!
Right. More importantly, watch out for intruders.
They've probably sent in an infantry squad anyway.
But you've realized that far too late.
What!
Heh heh! We got here ages ago!
Kanji, Amuro, I'm so glad you're safe.
I was sure you'd come for us.
Besides, watching these guys fight was pretty fun.
What'd you say?!
You've got some nerve!
Military Police! You're completely surrounded! Come quietly!
Heh! Even the Military Police showed up? You Paradigm Corporation dogs!
Say what you like!
The Military Police will deal with these guys! Iron Gear crew, hurry back!
Thanks, Mr. Dastun!
Let's go. The enemy's main force is getting close.

rows.notes: [editorial 8] 'I believed you'd come' stiff for Kanji | [editorial 13] insult reads as a fragment without 'You'

segments.en: I'm glad to see everyone safe.
It's thanks to the Megadeus.
Megadeus? You mean that machine from before?
That's what the Military Police guy said. It shows up out of nowhere, and when the fight's over, it disappears underground.
Did I do the right thing...?
You mean using Big O.
Yes...
Standing against Grados means taking part in the war.
Perhaps I was a little rash...
Do you regret it?
...I'd rather not think so.
Roger, you would have had to fight one way or another.
And sooner or later, you'll be leaving this city.
It's your job, Roger Smith.
